name: capcomd
description: Durable orchestration for swarms of coding agents: spawn Claude Code and Codex agents in isolated VMs, verify and review their work, merge only the tested commits.

interface.shortDescription: Run a swarm of coding agents in VMs; land only verified work
interface.longDescription: Your agent orchestrates through capcomd: it spawns Claude Code and Codex agents in isolated VMs, each on its own branch, verifies their work with your checks and a reviewer agent, and merges only the exact commits that passed. Runs are durable: they survive crashes and outlive the session.
defaultPrompt: Use capcomd to fix the failing tests: one worker per file, each verified and reviewed, then merged
Set up capcomd for this repository
Show my capcomd runs and what's waiting for approval
